record.bible_text: On that night<WH03915> could not<WH05074><WTH8804> the king<WH04428> sleep<WH08142>, and he commanded<WH0559><WTH8799> to bring<WH0935><WTH8687> the book<WH05612> of records<WH02146> of the chronicles<WH01697><WH03117>; and they were read<WH07121><WTH8737> before<WH06440> the king<WH04428>. <RF>could...: Heb. the king's sleep fled away<Rf>

And it was found<WH04672><WTH8735> written<WH03789><WTH8803>, that Mordecai<WH04782> had told<WH05046><WTH8689> of Bigthana<WH0904> and Teresh<WH08657>, two<WH08147> of the king's<WH04428> chamberlains<WH05631>, the keepers<WH08104><WTH8802> of the door<WH05592>, who sought<WH01245><WTH8765> to lay<WH07971><WTH8800> hand<WH03027> on the king<WH04428> Ahasuerus<WH0325>. <RF>Bigthana: also called, Bigthan<Rf> <RF>door: Heb. threshold<Rf>

And the king<WH04428> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, What honour<WH03366> and dignity<WH01420> hath been done<WH06213><WTH8738> to Mordecai<WH04782> for this? And the king<WH04428> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Who <FI>is<Fi> in the court<WH02691>? And the king's<WH04428> servants<WH05288> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Behold, Haman<WH02001> standeth<WH05975><WTH8802> in the court<WH02691>. And the king<WH04428> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Let him come in<WH0935><WTH8799>.

So Haman<WH02001> came in<WH0935><WTH8799>. And the king<WH04428> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, What shall be done<WH06213><WTH8800> unto the man<WH0376> whom the king<WH04428> delighteth<WH02654><WTH8804> to honour<WH03366>? Now Haman<WH02001> thought<WH0559><WTH8799> in his heart<WH03820>, To whom would the king<WH04428> delight<WH02654><WTH8799> to do<WH06213><WTH8800> honour<WH03366> more<WH03148> than to myself? <RF>whom the king...: Heb. in whose honour the king delighteth<Rf>

And Haman<WH02001> answered<WH0559><WTH8799> the king<WH04428>, For the man<WH0376> whom the king<WH04428> delighteth<WH02654><WTH8804> to honour<WH03366>, <RF>whom the king...: Heb. in whose honour the king delighteth<Rf>

Let the royal<WH04438> apparel<WH03830> be brought<WH0935><WTH8686> which the king<WH04428> <FI>useth<Fi> to wear<WH03847><WTH8804>, and the horse<WH05483> that the king<WH04428> rideth<WH07392><WTH8804> upon, and the crown<WH03804> royal<WH04438> which is set<WH05414><WTH8738> upon his head<WH07218>: <RF>Let...: Heb. Let them bring the royal apparel<Rf> <RF>which the king...: Heb. wherewith the king clotheth himself<Rf>

And let this apparel<WH03830> and horse<WH05483> be delivered<WH05414><WTH8800> to the hand<WH03027> of one<WH0376> of the king's<WH04428> most noble<WH06579> princes<WH08269>, that they may array<WH03847><WTH8689> the man<WH0376> <FI>withal<Fi> whom the king<WH04428> delighteth<WH02654><WTH8804> to honour<WH03366>, and bring<WH07392><WTH8689> him on horseback<WH05483> through the street<WH07339> of the city<WH05892>, and proclaim<WH07121><WTH8804> before<WH06440> him, Thus shall it be done<WH06213><WTH8735> to the man<WH0376> whom the king<WH04428> delighteth<WH02654><WTH8804> to honour<WH03366>. <RF>bring...: Heb. cause him to ride<Rf>

Then the king<WH04428> said<WH0559><WTH8799> to Haman<WH02001>, Make haste<WH04116><WTH8761>, <FI>and<Fi> take<WH03947><WTH8798> the apparel<WH03830> and the horse<WH05483>, as thou hast said<WH01696><WTH8765>, and do<WH06213><WTH8798> even so to Mordecai<WH04782> the Jew<WH03064>, that sitteth<WH03427><WTH8802> at the king's<WH04428> gate<WH08179>: let nothing<WH01697> fail<WH05307><WTH8686> of all that thou hast spoken<WH01696><WTH8765>. <RF>let...: Heb. suffer not a whit to fall<Rf>

Then took<WH03947><WTH8799> Haman<WH02001> the apparel<WH03830> and the horse<WH05483>, and arrayed<WH03847><WTH8686> Mordecai<WH04782>, and brought him on horseback<WH07392><WTH8686> through the street<WH07339> of the city<WH05892>, and proclaimed<WH07121><WTH8799> before<WH06440> him, Thus shall it be done<WH06213><WTH8735> unto the man<WH0376> whom the king<WH04428> delighteth<WH02654><WTH8804> to honour<WH03366>.<CM>

And Mordecai<WH04782> came again<WH07725><WTH8799> to the king's<WH04428> gate<WH08179>. But Haman<WH02001> hasted<WH01765><WTH8738> to his house<WH01004> mourning<WH057>, and having his head<WH07218> covered<WH02645><WTH8802>.

And Haman<WH02001> told<WH05608><WTH8762> Zeresh<WH02238> his wife<WH0802> and all his friends<WH0157><WTH8802> every <FI>thing<Fi> that had befallen<WH07136><WTH8804> him. Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> his wise men<WH02450> and Zeresh<WH02238> his wife<WH0802> unto him, If Mordecai<WH04782> <FI>be<Fi> of the seed<WH02233> of the Jews<WH03064>, before<WH06440> whom thou hast begun<WH02490><WTH8689> to fall<WH05307><WTH8800>, thou shalt not prevail<WH03201><WTH8799> against him, but shalt surely<WH05307><WTH8800> fall<WH05307><WTH8799> before<WH06440> him.

And while they <FI>were<Fi> yet talking<WH01696><WTH8764> with him, came<WH05060><WTH8689> the king's<WH04428> chamberlains<WH05631>, and hasted<WH0926><WTH8686> to bring<WH0935><WTH8687> Haman<WH02001> unto the banquet<WH04960> that Esther<WH0635> had prepared<WH06213><WTH8804>.<CM>
